measurementFrame: Country-level baseline context, not AI-attributed country estimates.
summary: The bundled records are retained from the original prototype as illustrative national energy, emissions, and population context. They should not be read as sourced estimates of AI-specific or data-center-specific energy consumption by country.

energyConsumed.label: National energy context
energyConsumed.provenance: Prototype value retained for visualization scale and interaction testing; not source-verified as an AI-attributed country estimate.

co2Emissions.label: National CO2 context
co2Emissions.provenance: Prototype value retained for emissions context; not source-verified as emissions caused by AI systems.

energyPerCapita.label: Energy context per capita
energyPerCapita.provenance: Derived in the prototype from the bundled energy and population values.

co2PerCapita.label: CO2 context per capita
co2PerCapita.provenance: Derived in the prototype from the bundled emissions and population values.

population.label: Population
population.provenance: Prototype population value used for per-capita calculations.

limitations: No authoritative per-country AI-attributed energy estimate is bundled with this prototype.
The current CO2 values are context metrics, not emissions caused by AI systems.
The country detail chart uses an illustrative trend until a sourced historical time series is connected.
Use this dataset for UX, interaction, and storytelling structure only until source-verified metrics are added.
